The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of [[Armor]].

== ''Obtainment'' ==
Has the same crafting recipe as regular Iron Armor but crafted with [[Hijacked Iron Ingot|Hijacked Iron Ingots]] instead of regular Iron Ingots.

== ''Usage'' ==
Like any armor set, Hijacked Iron Armor can be worn for extra protection.
*While worn, Hijacked Iron Boots will prevent lethal fall damage '''once'''.  This ability resets following a two-minute cooldown period.
*When the full set is worn, the wearer is immune to the [[Bleeding]] effect, but takes 5.5 times the damage from fire.
